$comment: Provenance sidecar (T2.1, GOV-REAL-DATA-001 rule 5). One entry per routed surface id that scripts/surface-guard extracts (every route and in-page tab): {endpoint, table, writer} with a REAL writer (user-action / importer / sync; never a seed, migration or fixture), or {register} naming an OPEN gap-register row of this app that explains why there is no live source yet, or {static} for a surface that renders no domain data. A surface with no entry is UNRESOLVED. Checked by `surface-guard provenance` (strict: the release preflight) and `provenance --report` (the test suite). Each entry was derived from the code path cited in `evidence`.

docs-tab:spotlight.static: The Spotlight customer manual tab of /docs (src/lib/docs/manifest.ts)

route:/.static: Marketing landing (DesktopLanding); no fetch, no domain data

route:/api/beta-requests.writer: user-action: the beta sign-up form (BetaSignupForm) posting to this route

route:/api/telemetry/event.writer: user-action: the signed-in browser posting its own events to this route

route:/auth/callback.writer: user-action: GoTrue sign-up / sign-in (Google through the platform OAuth edge, Apple id_token exchange, email+password)

route:/auth/entitlement.endpoint: platform GoTrue GET /auth/v1/user, then PostgREST GET /rest/v1/user_product_licenses
route:/auth/entitlement.writer: user-action: GoTrue sign-up / sign-in (Google through the platform OAuth edge, Apple id_token exchange, email+password)

route:/beta.static: Beta sign-up page; reads no data (its form posts to /api/beta-requests, which carries its own provenance)

route:/coachs-corner.static: Marketing copy from src/data/superpowers; no fetch

route:/docs/*?.static: Customer manual pages shipped in the build (src/lib/docs/manifest.ts); access is a GoTrue + licence check, the content is not domain data

route:/login.writer: user-action: GoTrue sign-up / sign-in (Google through the platform OAuth edge, Apple id_token exchange, email+password)

route:/pricing.static: Plan copy; no fetch, no checkout (Stripe checkout is register O-05)

route:/supabase/*?.writer: user-action: GoTrue sign-up / sign-in (Google through the platform OAuth edge, Apple id_token exchange, email+password)
